mutations.name: B-length: accept a frame one byte past the advertised ceiling
B-boundary: do not advance at an exact header chunk end
B-boundary: leave one byte of a consumed Connect frame
B-order: prepend received chunks instead of appending
B-copy-order: reverse complete-payload chunk placement
mutations.replacement: payload.set(chunk.subarray(offset, offset + take), length - written - take);

mutations.name: B-pending: reject exactly 100 MiB instead of only larger pending data
B-grpc-boundary: leave one byte of a consumed gRPC frame
B-inflate: tighten the decompressed-size ceiling by one byte
